title: StableGas Pony
tagline: ⏱️ StableGas Pony: Syncing attention use with bulk group buys for gas fee optimization 🔁🌐
description:
StableGas Pony is a new way to make blockchain transactions smarter and cheaper by linking human attention patterns with group bulk buys. Instead of everyone paying gas fees separately, the system detects when users’ attention usage aligns and pools their transactions together. This optimizes gas fees, reduces costs, and makes blockchain activity more accessible for individuals and communities.
The vision is to bridge human time-value with financial efficiency—creating a tokenized sync model where people’s attention isn’t wasted, but rather becomes part of a collective optimization mechanism. It’s not only about saving fees, but also about rethinking how individual usage patterns can add up to systemic efficiency.
how_its_made:
Stablecoin integration (USDC via Circle APIs): for stable and reliable transaction value.
Attention sync model (custom AI logic, Python backend): measures timing of user intent/attention and groups them.
Frontend (Swift for iOS prototype + React web dashboard): user-facing visualization of attention sync and group confirmation status.
Partner technologies:
Circle’s USDC & APIs → provided stable and programmable payments.
Hacky but notable parts:
Designed a lightweight attention-to-transaction matching layer, simulating user focus data as a driver for when to trigger pooled transactions.
Created a bulk send optimization logic where 80% of a group must confirm within 5 days to lock in gas savings.
Integrated a dynamic dashboard showing how much gas fees were saved per group action in real time.
